items.raw_excerpt: Allahabad HC dismisses petition against Jauhar University's demolition, citing lack of maintainability by an outsider representative.
items.summary_en: The Allahabad High Court has dismissed a petition challenging the demolition of Jauhar University. The court ruled that an outsider representative cannot file such a petition. The government had contested the maintainability of the legal challenge.
items.summary_ko: 알라하바드 고등법원은 자우하르 대학교 청산에 대한 이의 제기를 기각했습니다. 법원은 외부 대표자가 이러한 소송을 제기할 수 없다고 판결했습니다. 정부는 법적 도전의 적격성에 이의를 제기했습니다.
items.title_en: Allahabad High Court dismisses petition against Jauhar University demolition

items.title_original: Allahabad HC dismisses petition in Jauhar University matter after government contests maintainability

items.raw_excerpt: Parts of southern Queensland have been drought-declared for the first time in two years, with farmers facing worsening conditions after at least 12 months of below-average rainfall.
items.summary_en: Farmers in southern Queensland are facing worse conditions after months of below-average rainfall. Local officials have declared a drought for parts of the area for the first time in two years. The drought declaration helps farmers receive government support.
items.summary_ko: 남부 퀸즈랜드 지역은 평년 이하의 강수량이 12개월 이상 지속되어 농민들이 어려움을 겪고 있다. 당국은 2년 만에 이 지역 일부에 가뭄을 선포했다. 가뭄 선포로 농민들은 정부 지원을 받을 수 있게 된다.
items.title_en: Parts of Queensland Get Drought Declaration for First Time in Two Years

items.raw_excerpt: A withdrawal of services by solicitors in dispute over payments made under the new legal aid system is continuing, despite positive engagement between the Law Society and Minister for Justice Jim O'Callaghan.
items.summary_en: Solicitors in Ireland are withdrawing services over a dispute about payments under the new legal aid system. Despite positive talks between the Law Society and the Justice Minister, the strike action will continue for three days.

items.raw_excerpt: Winter ills and chills are upon us, but while there are plenty of viruses going around, a health modeller says the flu season is yet to peak.
items.summary_en: A health modeller says New Zealand's flu season is starting later than usual. While many winter viruses are spreading, the peak has not arrived yet.

items.raw_excerpt: You've probably noticed a wide range of vehicles zipping around Italy's streets, from tiny cars that look like toy robots to the quaint three-wheeled Piaggio Ape. But are any of these available to people without an Italian driver's licence?
items.summary_en: Italy has many unique vehicles, from tiny cars to the three-wheeled Piaggio Ape. Some of these quirky machines can be driven without an Italian driver's licence. Whether you can depends on the vehicle type and its engine size.

items.raw_excerpt: Finland's architectural legacy has reached a new milestone.
items.summary_en: Thirteen buildings and sites designed by Finnish architect Alvar Aalto have been added to the Unesco World Heritage List. The sites showcase Aalto's lasting influence on modern architecture. This milestone honors Finland's rich architectural legacy.

items.title_en: Thirteen Alvar Aalto Sites Join Unesco World Heritage List

items.summary_en: A 3.7 magnitude earthquake hit the monastic peninsula of Mount Athos on Monday morning. The tremor was centered about 15 kilometers northwest of Karyes and was shallow. Scientists say it matches recent seismic activity that has been monitored on the peninsula.
items.summary_ko: 28일 오전 그리스의 수도원 반도 산아토스에서 규모 3.7의 지진이 발생했습니다. 진원지는 카레스 북서쪽 약 15km 지점의얕은 곳으로 확인되었습니다. 전문가들은 이번 지진이 최근 반도에서 관측된 활동과 비슷한 패턴이라고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: Small Earthquake Rattles Mount Athos in Greece
